nodes.label: Magnetic Connector Top-Wall Slot
nodes.rationale: Battery door rejected: the 21x7 mm face won't pass the ~11x12.6 mm opening.

nodes.label: Scale 7.55 px/mm
nodes.rationale: Highest px/mm gives the smallest (safest) board; ruler was printed at ~75%.

nodes.label: Display Window 57 x 21 mm
nodes.rationale: E-paper active area (23.7 mm) is taller than window; ~14 pixel rows hidden.

nodes.label: AP2112K-3.3 Regulator
nodes.rationale: 600 mA covers Wi-Fi peaks; its 55 uA quiescent dominates off-state drain but was specified.

nodes.label: Camera Supplies (copied from Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 Sense)
nodes.norm_label: camera supplies (copied from seeed xiao esp32s3 sense)
nodes.rationale: Seeed's OV5640 module is designed for this circuit, so it's proven; feeding from SYS keeps camera off the 3.3 V LDO.

nodes.label: MCP73831 Charger
nodes.rationale: 50 mA (0.5 C) is gentle on a 100 mAh cell in a closed case.

nodes.label: ON Key on RTC Pin IO7
nodes.norm_label: on key on rtc pin io7

nodes.label: TCA8418 Keypad Scanner
nodes.rationale: Separate I2C bus (IO1/IO2) so an unpowered camera cannot drag the keypad bus low, including in exam mode.

nodes.label: C20 Pump Cap 4.7 uF 50 V 1206
nodes.rationale: Pump node ~20 V where 25 V X5R loses most capacitance.

nodes.label: Firmware Camera Power-Off Sequence
nodes.rationale: Avoid gpio_reset_pin() pull-ups back-powering the switched-off camera.

nodes.label: D7 SMF5.0A VBUS TVS
nodes.rationale: Hot-plugging a magnetic contact can ring above the charger's 7 V abs max.

nodes.label: R12 E-Paper Sense = 3 Ohm
nodes.rationale: B/W V4 panel reference and Waveshare HAT use 3 Ohm; 0.47 Ohm would set current limit 6x too high.

nodes.label: SCCB Pull-ups R18/R19 to CAM_2V8
nodes.rationale: Pulling to the camera's own rail avoids leaking into an unpowered camera.

nodes.label: STAT -> IO35 via Schottky D6 + R20
nodes.norm_label: stat -> io35 via schottky d6 + r20
nodes.rationale: MCP73831 STAT drives 5 V push-pull; diode lets it only pull the 3.3 V pin low.

nodes.label: USBLC6 Reference Pin on +3V3
nodes.rationale: Prevents ESP32 USB pull-up leaking onto magnet VBUS and confusing cable detect.

nodes.label: VBUS Sense Divider 10k/20k
nodes.rationale: Keeps VBUS firmly at 0 V without a cable; reads 3.17-3.5 V with a cable.

nodes.label: E-Paper FPC Slot 1.0x14 mm at x=172.9
nodes.norm_label: e-paper fpc slot 1.0x14 mm at x=172.9
nodes.rationale: FPC folds behind panel; 14.3 mm length budget.

nodes.label: J1 FPC_24P DualContact CamReversed
nodes.rationale: Straight flat cable lands mirrored on standard numbering (~75% confidence); dual contact means a 180 deg twist fixes a wrong reading.

nodes.label: J3 Magnet SMD Header C42379197
nodes.rationale: SMD 5 mm header is 3.5 mm lower than THT and avoids hand-solder fee.

nodes.label: Key Pad Footprints
nodes.rationale: Function pads shrunk to 6.0x4.5 to keep 0.3 mm from posts and edge.

nodes.label: SHOU HAN C6364666 Dual-Contact FPC Socket
nodes.norm_label: shou han c6364666 dual-contact fpc socket

nodes.label: Camera GPIO Map Reordered (Stage 6)
nodes.rationale: Reordered so the camera bus leaves the ESP32 module in J1's pin order, enabling a clean ribbon route; firmware must use the new map.

nodes.label: Casio fx-300ES Plus Case
nodes.rationale: New board fits inside an unmodified case; only a ~6 mm camera hole is drilled in the back cover.
